title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: OpenAI API
providers.scope_notes: OpenAI API Platform organizations and projects (platform.openai.com); ChatGPT workspace and Codex credentials out of scope except where shared WIF docs mention them.
controls_unknown: Whether API keys are subject to SSO or IdP conditional access (no statement found).
Whether the IP allowlist covers Administration API calls made with admin keys.
Whether audit logging must be activated and its retention period (help center pages blocked to fetch).
Whether inference/data-read API calls (e.g. GET /v1/files) appear in the audit log; it is described as user actions and configuration changes.
Whether deleting a service account or WIF mapping invalidates already-issued WIF tokens before expiry.
Lifetime, listing and admin revocation of legacy user API keys.
API key secret prefix format (not stated in fetched docs).

authentication.summary: Organization-level key used only for Administration API endpoints (users, projects, keys, audit logs). Owned by an org owner.

federation.details: Workload identity tokens cannot call Admin API endpoints; an admin key is required.

ip_restriction.boundary: IP allowlist covers API requests; docs do not say explicitly whether Administration API calls with admin keys are included.

lifetime.summary: Optional expires_in_seconds at creation; no expiry if omitted

renewal.summary: Create a new admin key and delete the old one.

administration.summary: Only roles with Organization Admin permission (org owner) manage admin keys. Create/list/delete via dashboard or /organization/admin_api_keys.
administration.conditions: Whether the max-lifetime policy applies to admin keys is not stated.

offboard.details: Help center says demoting an owner can invalidate their admin API keys; it does not say what happens when the owner is removed entirely, and 'can' is not a guarantee.

inventory.details: GET /v1/organization/admin_api_keys lists organization admin API keys.

expiry.api: POST /organization/admin_api_keys with expires_in_seconds (max 31536000); check expires_at via GET /organization/admin_api_keys/{key_id}

offboard.ui: API Platform settings > People > Members > Roles (demote owner) or Remove

log_sources.name: Audit logs (GET /v1/organization/audit_logs)
log_sources.notes: User actions and configuration changes; actor is session or api_key with key tracking id. Read with an admin key. Activation and retention not verified.

anomaly_cues: Key used from IP that triggers ip_not_authorized
api_key.created by unexpected user or outside change window

containment.steps: Delete via dashboard admin-keys page or DELETE /v1/organization/admin_api_keys/{key_id}.
containment.notes: Docs state API key revocation takes effect within a few seconds; the statement is for API keys in general, not admin keys specifically. Keys are per-request bearer secrets with no derived tokens.

unknown: Whether admin key reads (list users, list audit logs) are themselves logged

calls.reveals: Org activity history, key ids, IPs

unknown: Whether admin-key read calls are logged
